work.title: Peer Gynt Suite No. 1
work.movement: IV. In the Hall of the Mountain King

version.value: Orchestral concert version from Suite No. 1, without chorus
version.note: The Musopen listing is for Peer Gynt Suite No. 1, Op. 46; the edition is not identified.

value.name: Czech National Symphony Orchestra (as the Musopen Symphony Orchestra)

performers.note: The Commons description names the orchestra. No conductor is named in the sources consulted.

date.note: Commons dates the file 7 April 2012 without saying whether that is the session, release or upload date; the Musopen Kickstarter project that paid for the recording completed in 2012. Only the year is used.

place.note: No venue or city is given for the session.

label.note: Musopen is a non-profit that raised money by Kickstarter to record music and release it to the public domain.

catalogue.note: The Internet Archive compilation has no catalogue number.

matrixTakeSides.note: A born-digital session has no matrix or take numbers.

credits.value: Uploaded to Wikimedia Commons by user Yodin
credits.note: Commons file history; no mastering engineer is named.

date.note: Commons upload date, not a session date.

processing.value: Ogg Vorbis file on Commons; MP3 access derivative generated by Commons
processing.note: No editing or normalisation by Contrapunctus; one complete source stream.

digital.format: MP3 access derivative of an Ogg Vorbis file; one source file, no concatenation or audio edits by Contrapunctus

composition.value: Public domain under ordinary life-plus-70 terms
composition.note: Grieg died on 4 September 1907. This says nothing about any modern edition.

recording.value: Public domain by Musopen’s release (Creative Commons Public Domain Mark); Commons tags the file {{PD-author}} for Musopen
recording.note: The Internet Archive compilation of the Musopen Kickstarter recordings carries the Public Domain Mark. Commons quotes Musopen’s requirement that uploaders warrant that content is in the public domain.

rights.creditLine: Edvard Grieg, In the Hall of the Mountain King (Peer Gynt Suite No. 1, Op. 46); Czech National Symphony Orchestra as the Musopen Symphony Orchestra, Musopen Kickstarter Project, 2012. Public domain; via Wikimedia Commons. No audio edits.

sources.title: Wikimedia Commons — Musopen, In the Hall Of The Mountain King
sources.locator: Description: performed by the Czech National Symphony Orchestra as the Musopen Symphony Orchestra for the Musopen Kickstarter Project; date 2012-04-07; licence tag PD-author (Musopen); uploaded 14 October 2012 by Yodin.

sources.title: Internet Archive — Musopen Kickstarter Music (lossless DVD compilation)
sources.locator: Date 2012-08; licence URL: Public Domain Mark 1.0; description lists “Grieg - Peer Gynt” among the music recorded and released into the public domain; the project completed in 2012.

sources.title: Finn Benestad — Edvard Grieg, Norsk biografisk leksikon
sources.locator: Dates: died 4 September 1907; Peer Gynt music 1874–75, Suite No. 1 published as Op. 46 in 1888 with “I Dovregubbens hall” as its fourth piece.
